def meterRun (T : Option Tree) (ss : List Tree) : Charged (Option (List (List Nat))) :=
 let g := meterGuard T ss
 if g.value then
  let c := meterCandidate T ss
  ⟨some c.value,g.work+c.work+8⟩
 else ⟨none,g.work+4⟩
@[simp] theorem meterRun_value (T : Option Tree) (ss : List Tree) : (meterRun T ss).value=run T ss := by
 cases h:allGood T ss <;> simp [meterRun,run,h]

def runPolynomial (n : Nat) : Nat := guardPolynomial (2*n)+candidatePolynomial n+8

theorem actual_run_work (t : Tree) (ss : List Tree) (hp : proper (some t) ss=true) :
 (meterRun (some t) ss).work≤runPolynomial (leaves t).length := by
 have volume := GenericForest.LocalPolynomial.state_size_bounds (some t) ss hp (leaves t).length (Nat.le_refl _)
 have guard := meterGuard_work (some t) ss (2*(leaves t).length) volume.1 volume.2.1 volume.2.2
 have candidate := actual_candidate_work t ss hp
 simp only [meterRun,runPolynomial]
 split <;> dsimp only <;> omega

theorem actual_run_polynomial (t : Tree) (ss : List Tree) (hp : proper (some t) ss=true) :
 (meterRun (some t) ss).work≤1048576*((leaves t).length+1)^4 :=
 Nat.le_trans (actual_run_work t ss hp) (runPolynomial_monomial _)

/-- Literal tail-first best. Both actual candidate costs are recomputed in each
comparison, with their full paint scan work retained. -/
def meterBest {α : Type} (cost : α → Charged Nat) : List α → Charged (Option α)
 | [] => ⟨none,4⟩
 | a::as =>
  let r := meterBest cost as
  match r.value with
  | none => ⟨some a,r.work+8⟩
  | some b =>
   let ca := cost a
   let cb := cost b
   ⟨if ca.value≤cb.value then some a else some b,r.work+ca.work+cb.work+12⟩
@[simp] theorem meterBest_value {α : Type} (cost : α → Charged Nat) (xs : List α) :
 (meterBest cost xs).value=RMAF.best (fun a=>(cost a).value) (fun _=>true) xs := by
 induction xs with
 | nil => rfl
 | cons a as ih => simp only [meterBest,ih,RMAF.best];cases h:RMAF.best (fun a=>(cost a).value) (fun _=>true) as <;> simp

theorem meterBest_work {α : Type} (cost : α → Charged Nat) (xs : List α) (C : Nat)
 (cap : ∀a,a∈xs→(cost a).work≤C) :
 (meterBest cost xs).work≤(2*C+12)*xs.length+4 := by

def meterTable (cs : List Nat) (owner : Nat→Charged Nat) : Tree→Charged (List Paint)
 | .leaf x => let o := owner x;⟨[.leaf x o.value],o.work+8⟩
 | .node l r =>
  let a := meterTable cs owner l
  let b := meterTable cs owner r
  let rows := cs.map (fun c=>meterRow c a.value b.value)
  ⟨rows.map Charged.value,a.work+b.work+(rows.map Charged.work).sum+8⟩
@[simp] theorem meterTable_value (cs : List Nat) (owner : Nat→Charged Nat) (t : Tree) :
 (meterTable cs owner t).value=table cs (fun x=>(owner x).value) t := by
 induction t with
 | leaf x => rfl
 | node l r il ir => simp [meterTable,il,ir,List.map_map,Function.comp_def,table]

def chooseCap (m N : Nat) : Nat := (48*N+12)*(m+1)+8
def nodeCharge (m N : Nat) : Nat := m*(2*chooseCap m N+8)+8
def tableCoefficient (C m N : Nat) : Nat := C+nodeCharge m N+16

/-- The four literal equality tests and both left append spines are charged.
The forest blocks retain empty components until the production final filter. -/
def meterSplit : Paint→Charged (List Nat×List (List Nat))
 | .leaf x _ => ⟨([x],[]),8⟩
 | .node c l r =>
  let a := meterSplit l
  let b := meterSplit r
  let la := if c==root l then a.value.1 else []
  let lb := if c==root r then b.value.1 else []
  let fa := if c==root l then a.value.2 else a.value.1::a.value.2
  let fb := if c==root r then b.value.2 else b.value.1::b.value.2
  ⟨(la++lb,fa++fb),a.work+b.work+4*(la.length+fa.length+2)+16⟩

def meterNonempty : List (List Nat)→Charged (List (List Nat))
 | [] => ⟨[],4⟩
 | B::F =>
  let m := meterNonempty F
  ⟨if B.isEmpty then m.value else B::m.value,m.work+8⟩
@[simp] theorem meterNonempty_value (F : List (List Nat)) :
 (meterNonempty F).value=F.filter (fun b=>!b.isEmpty) := by
 induction F with
 | nil => rfl
 | cons B F ih => cases B <;> simp [meterNonempty,ih]
theorem meterNonempty_work (F : List (List Nat)) : (meterNonempty F).work=8*F.length+4 := by
 induction F with
 | nil => rfl
 | cons B F ih => simp only [meterNonempty,List.length_cons,Nat.mul_add,Nat.mul_one];omega

def meterBlocks (p : Paint) : Charged (List (List Nat)) :=
 let m := meterSplit p
 let n := meterNonempty (m.value.1::m.value.2)
 ⟨n.value,m.work+n.work+8⟩

def meterOwner (x : Nat) : List Tree→Charged Nat
 | [] => ⟨0,4⟩
 | s::ss =>
  let ls := meterLabels s
  let m := meterContains x ls.value
  if m.value then ⟨0,ls.work+m.work+8⟩ else
   let r := meterOwner x ss
   ⟨r.value+1,ls.work+m.work+r.work+8⟩
@[simp] theorem meterOwner_value (x : Nat) (ss : List Tree) :
 (meterOwner x ss).value=owner ss x := by
 induction ss with
 | nil => simp [meterOwner,owner]
 | cons s ss ih => by_cases h:x∈leaves s <;> simp [meterOwner,owner,meterLabels_value,ih,List.findIdx_cons,h]

def ownerRowCap (N : Nat) := 8*(N+1)*N+4*(N+1)+8

theorem meterOwner_work (x : Nat) (ss : List Tree) (N : Nat)
 (hs : ∀s,s∈ss→treeNodes s≤N) :
 (meterOwner x ss).work≤ss.length*ownerRowCap N+4 := by

theorem actual_candidate_work (t : Tree) (ss : List Tree) (hp : proper (some t) ss=true) :
 (meterCandidate (some t) ss).work≤candidatePolynomial (leaves t).length := by
 let n := (leaves t).length
 have volume := GenericForest.LocalPolynomial.state_size_bounds (some t) ss hp n (Nat.le_refl _)
 have ht : treeNodes t≤2*n := volume.1
 have hs := volume.2.2
 have source : ∀s,s∈ss→treeNodes s≤2*n := fun s hm=>(GenericForest.LocalPolynomial.source_size_bounds (some t) ss hp n (Nat.le_refl _) s hm).1
 have ownerwork : ∀x,x∈leaves t→(meterOwner x ss).work≤2*n*ownerRowCap (2*n)+4 := by
  intro x _
  have h := meterOwner_work x ss (2*n) source
  have mul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (ownerRowCap (2*n)) hs
  omega
 have nonempty : List.range ss.length≠[] := by
  have ne := some_sources_nonempty t ss hp
  simp only [ne_eq,List.range_eq_nil,List.length_eq_zero_iff]
  exact ne
 have paint := meterSolve_work (List.range ss.length) (fun x=>meterOwner x ss) t nonempty _ (2*n) ht ownerwork
 simp only [List.length_range] at paint
 have raise := solveBill_mono (Nat.le_refl (2*n*ownerRowCap (2*n)+4)) hs (Nat.le_refl (2*n))
 have bounds : paintNodes (meterSolve (List.range ss.length) (fun x=>meterOwner x ss) t).value≤2*n := by
  rw [paintNodes_erase,meterSolve_erase _ _ _ nonempty]
  exact ht
 have block := meterBlocks_work _ (2*n) bounds
 simp only [meterCandidate,candidatePolynomial]
 dsimp only [n] at paint raise block hs
 omega

theorem actual_paint_scalars (t : Tree) (ss : List Tree) (hp : proper (some t) ss=true)
 (L : Nat) (labels : ∀x,x∈leaves t→x<L) :
 PaintScalars L ss.length (meterSolve (List.range ss.length) (fun x=>meterOwner x ss) t).value := by
 rw [meterSolve_value]
 simp only [meterOwner_value]
 exact valid_scalars (actual_paint_spec t ss hp).1 L ss.length labels (fun c hc=>List.mem_range.1 hc)

theorem cherry_select_envelope (T S : Tree) (N : Nat)
 (tn : treeNodes T≤N) (sn : treeNodes S≤N) :
 (meterSelect T S).value=CherryBranching.select T S ∧
 (meterSelect T S).work≤2048*(N+1)^5 :=
 ⟨meterSelect_value T S,meterSelect_bound T S N tn sn⟩

/-- Public primitive Rule4 envelope. The raw head caps are proved from
rawChoices membership, not supplied by a successful guard. -/
theorem rule4_select_envelope (T S : Tree) (N : Nat)
 (tn : treeNodes T≤N) (sn : treeNodes S≤N) :
 (meterRule4Select T S).value=Rule4.select T S ∧
 (meterRule4Select T S).work≤262144*(N+1)^6 :=
 ⟨meterRule4Select_value T S,meterRule4Select_bound T S N tn sn⟩

/-- Calls in both orientations have the same uniform envelope. -/
theorem earlier_clear_primitive_envelopes (T S : Tree) (N : Nat)
 (tn : treeNodes T≤N) (sn : treeNodes S≤N) :
 ((meterSelect T S).work+(meterSelect S T).work)+
 ((meterRule4Select T S).work+(meterRule4Select S T).work)≤1048576*(N+1)^6 := by
 have f:=cap_lift N 2048 5 6 _ (meterSelect_bound T S N tn sn) (by decide)
 have r:=cap_lift N 2048 5 6 _ (meterSelect_bound S T N sn tn) (by decide)
 have a:=meterRule4Select_bound T S N tn sn
 have b:=meterRule4Select_bound S T N sn tn

/-- Raw heads are actual source vertices, before any LocalGuard succeeds. -/
theorem rawChoice_head (T S : Tree) (raw : Rule4.RawChoice) (h : raw∈Rule4.rawChoices T S) : raw.cHead.length≤treeNodes S := by
 unfold Rule4.rawChoices at h
 obtain ⟨ab,hab,h⟩:=List.mem_flatMap.1 h
 obtain ⟨ac,hac,h⟩:=List.mem_flatMap.1 h
 split at h
 · obtain ⟨q,hq,h⟩:=List.mem_flatMap.1 h
   obtain ⟨r,hr,eq⟩:=List.mem_map.1 h
   subst raw
   exact pendant_address S ab.1 ab.2 q hq

def meterFirstChoice (T S : Tree) (hp : Rule4.Priority T S) : List Rule4.RawChoice→ChoiceMeasured T S
 | []=>⟨none,1,[]⟩
 | x::xs=>let g:=meterLocalGuard T S x
   if h:g.value=true then
    let proof : Rule4.LocalGuard T S x:=of_decide_eq_true ((meterLocalGuard_value T S x).symm.trans h)
    ⟨some ⟨x,hp,proof⟩,g.work+4,[(x,true)]⟩
   else let r:=meterFirstChoice T S hp xs
        ⟨r.value,g.work+r.work+4,(x,false)::r.checks⟩

def meterFront (q : Nat) (T S : Tree) : Charged (Front T S) :=
 let p:=meterOrdinaryProper T S
 if p.value then
  let d:=meterPretest T S
  match d.value with
  | .refused=>⟨.stop none,p.work+d.work+4⟩
  | .found c=>
    let f:=meterForest S c
    ⟨.stop (if DepthOne.cutCost c≤q then some f.value else none),p.work+d.work+f.work+8⟩
  | .rejected=>let e:=meterEarly T S;⟨.selected e.value,p.work+d.work+e.work+4⟩
 else ⟨.stop none,p.work+2⟩
@[simp] theorem meterFront_value (q T S) : (meterFront q T S).value=front q T S := by
 simp only [meterFront,front,meterOrdinaryProper_value,meterPretest_value,meterForest_value,meterEarly_value]
 repeat first | rfl | split

/-- Binds the found prefix to the unchanged frozen solve at every budget,
including budgets larger than the current reduced leaf count. -/
theorem front_found_solve (T S : Tree) (q : Nat) (c : Option RMAF.Vertex)
 (hp : DepthOne.proper T S=true) (found : DepthOne.pretest01 T S=.found c) :
 FastOrdinary.solve q T S=(if DepthOne.cutCost c≤q then some (DepthOne.forest S c) else none) ∧
 front q T S=.stop (FastOrdinary.solve q T S) := by
 have actual : FastOrdinary.solve q T S=(if DepthOne.cutCost c≤q then some (DepthOne.forest S c) else none) := by
  rw [FastOrdinary.solve.eq_def]
  simp only [hp,ite_true,found]
 exact ⟨actual,by simp only [front,hp,ite_true,found,actual]⟩

theorem front_rejected_binding (T S : Tree) (q : Nat)
 (hp : DepthOne.proper T S=true) (rejected : DepthOne.pretest01 T S=.rejected) :
 front q T S=.selected (FastOrdinary.early T S) := by simp [front,hp,rejected]

theorem meterFront_bound (T S : Tree) (q N : Nat) (tn : treeNodes T≤N) (sn : treeNodes S≤N) :
 (meterFront q T S).work≤2097152*(N+1)^6 := by

/-- Explicit resources for a reduced current state. NT,NS may be original
sizes; Q bounds current q separately. There is no hypothesis q<=current n. -/
def ScalarDomain (T S : Tree) (q L Q : Nat) : Prop :=
 (∀x∈leaves T,x<2^L) ∧ (∀x∈leaves S,x<2^L) ∧ q≤Q

def structuralEnvelope (NT NS L Q : Nat) : Nat :=
 2097152*(NT+NS+L+Q+1)^6

theorem meterFront_resources (T S : Tree) (q NT NS L Q : Nat)
 (tn : treeNodes T≤NT) (sn : treeNodes S≤NS) (domain : ScalarDomain T S q L Q) :
 (meterFront q T S).work≤structuralEnvelope NT NS L Q := by
 exact meterFront_bound T S q (NT+NS+L+Q) (by omega) (by omega)

/-- A weighted structural model only. A binary provider must separately prove
that fee covers every unit scalar equality/inequality/increment, label copy,
comparison with q, and administrative address/counter slot in this source sheet.
It is not an assumption that the whole selector already has a cost bound. -/
def weightedFront (fee q : Nat) (T S : Tree) : Nat := fee*(meterFront q T S).work

theorem weightedFront_bound (fee q : Nat) (T S : Tree) (NT NS L Q : Nat)
 (tn : treeNodes T≤NT) (sn : treeNodes S≤NS) (domain : ScalarDomain T S q L Q) :
 weightedFront fee q T S≤fee*structuralEnvelope NT NS L Q :=
 Nat.mul_le_mul_left fee (meterFront_resources T S q NT NS L Q tn sn domain)

/-- All no-cut and one-cut checks, valid and invalid, and all best-tail
comparisons are included. No agreement or successful-check premise is needed. -/
theorem meterPretest_bound (T S : Tree) (N : Nat) (tn : treeNodes T≤N) (sn : treeNodes S≤N) :
 (meterPretest T S).work≤400000*(N+1)^6 := by
 have p:=cap_lift N 128 2 6 _ (meterOrdinaryProper_bound T S N tn sn) (by decide)
 have c:=cap_lift N 32 2 6 _ (meterCandidates_bound S N sn) (by decide)
 have b:=meterBest_bound DepthOne.cutCost (meterCandidate T S) (DepthOne.candidates S) (300000*(N+1)^5)
  (fun x hx=>meterCandidate_bound T S x hx N tn sn)
 have coeff : 300000*(N+1)^5+10≤300010*(N+1)^5:=by have pos:=Nat.one_le_pow 5 (N+1) (by omega);omega
 have scale:=Nat.mul_le_mul coeff (Nat.add_le_add_right sn 1)
 rw [candidates_length] at b
 have bb : (meterBest DepthOne.cutCost (meterCandidate T S) (DepthOne.candidates S)).work≤300010*(N+1)^6:=
  Nat.le_trans b (by simpa only [show 6=5+1 from rfl,Nat.pow_succ,Nat.mul_assoc] using scale)
 have pos : 1≤(N+1)^6:=Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
 simp only [meterPretest,meterCandidates_value]
 split <;> simp only [Charged.work] <;> omega

def meterVertices : Tree→Charged (List RMAF.Vertex)
 | .leaf _=>⟨[[]],4⟩
 | .node l r=>let a:=meterVertices l;let b:=meterVertices r
   ⟨[]::(a.value.map (false::·)++b.value.map (true::·)),a.work+b.work+8*(a.value.length+b.value.length+1)⟩
@[simp] theorem meterVertices_value (T : Tree) : (meterVertices T).value=HardParent.vertices T := by
 induction T <;> simp_all [meterVertices,HardParent.vertices,prependSide]
theorem vertices_depthone (T : Tree) : HardParent.vertices T=DepthOne.vertices T := by
 induction T <;> simp_all [HardParent.vertices,DepthOne.vertices,prependSide]
theorem vertices_length (T : Tree) : (HardParent.vertices T).length=treeNodes T := by
 induction T <;> simp_all [HardParent.vertices,prependSide,treeNodes];omega
theorem vertices_address (T : Tree) (v : RMAF.Vertex) (hv : v∈HardParent.vertices T) : v.length≤treeNodes T := by
 induction T generalizing v with
 | leaf x=>simp [HardParent.vertices] at hv;subst v;simp [treeNodes]
 | node l r il ir=>
  simp only [HardParent.vertices,prependSide,List.mem_cons,List.mem_append,List.mem_map] at hv
  rcases hv with rfl|⟨u,hu,rfl⟩|⟨u,hu,rfl⟩
  · simp [treeNodes]
  · have h:=il u hu;simp only [List.length_cons,treeNodes];omega
  · have h:=ir u hu;simp only [List.length_cons,treeNodes];omega

theorem meterVertices_bound (T : Tree) (N : Nat) (tn : treeNodes T≤N) :
 (meterVertices T).work≤8*(N+1)*treeNodes T := by
 induction T with
 | leaf x=>simp only [meterVertices,treeNodes,Nat.mul_one];omega
 | node l r il ir=>
  have ln : treeNodes l≤N:=by simp only [treeNodes] at tn;omega
  have rn : treeNodes r≤N:=by simp only [treeNodes] at tn;omega
  have a:=il ln;have b:=ir rn
  simp only [meterVertices,meterVertices_value,vertices_length,treeNodes,Nat.mul_add,Nat.mul_one] at a b tn ⊢;omega

def meterPendantCheck (S : Tree) (a b : Nat) (v : RMAF.Vertex) : Charged Bool :=
 let d:=meterDropLast v
 let m:=meterMinimal [a,b] S;let c:=meterVertexContains d.value m.value
 let n:=meterMinimal [a,b] S;let e:=meterVertexContains v n.value
 ⟨!v.isEmpty&&c.value&&(!e.value),d.work+m.work+c.work+n.work+e.work+4⟩
@[simp] theorem meterPendantCheck_value (S a b v) :
 (meterPendantCheck S a b v).value=(!v.isEmpty&&(minimalVertices [a,b] S).contains v.dropLast&&(!(minimalVertices [a,b] S).contains v)) := by
 simp [meterPendantCheck]

theorem meterPendantCheck_bound (S : Tree) (a b N : Nat) (v : RMAF.Vertex)
 (sn : treeNodes S≤N) (vn : v.length≤N) : (meterPendantCheck S a b v).work≤256*(N+1)^3 := by
 have d:=meterDropLast_bound v
 have m:=minimal_two_bound S a b N sn
 have ml:=Nat.le_trans (minimal_length [a,b] S) sn
 have dv : v.dropLast.length≤N:=by simp only [List.length_dropLast];omega
 have cb:=meterVertexContains_bound v.dropLast (minimalVertices [a,b] S) N dv
 have eb:=meterVertexContains_bound v (minimalVertices [a,b] S) N vn
 have k:=Nat.mul_le_mul_left (8*(N+1)) (Nat.add_le_add_right ml 1)
 have c:=Nat.le_trans cb k;have e:=Nat.le_trans eb k
 have p1:=pow_mono N 1 3 (by decide);have p2:=pow_mono N 2 3 (by decide)
 have pos : 1≤(N+1)^3:=Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
 simp only [Nat.pow_one,Nat.pow_two,Nat.mul_assoc] at c e p1 p2
 simp only [meterPendantCheck,meterDropLast_value,meterMinimal_value];omega

def meterPendant (S : Tree) (a b : Nat) : Charged (List RMAF.Vertex) :=
 let v:=meterVertices S;let f:=meterFilter (meterPendantCheck S a b) v.value
 ⟨f.value,v.work+f.work+2⟩
@[simp] theorem meterPendant_value (S a b) : (meterPendant S a b).value=HardParent.pendantOriginal S a b := by
 simp [meterPendant,HardParent.pendantOriginal]
theorem meterPendant_bound (S : Tree) (a b N : Nat) (sn : treeNodes S≤N) :
 (meterPendant S a b).work≤512*(N+1)^4 := by

/-- Mathematical input representation; not a native Nat conversion cost claim. -/
def encode : Nat → Nat → List Bool
 | 0,_=>[]
 | W+1,n=>decide (n%2=1)::encode W (n/2)
@[simp] theorem encode_length (W n : Nat) : (encode W n).length=W := by
 induction W generalizing n <;> simp [encode, *]

theorem bit_mod_two (n : Nat) : bit (decide (n%2=1))=n%2 := by
 have h:=Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one n
 rcases h with h|h <;> simp [h,bit]

theorem encode_value (W n : Nat) (bound : n<2^W) : decode (encode W n)=n := by
 induction W generalizing n with
 | zero=>
  have eq : n=0:=by simpa using bound
  subst n;rfl
 | succ W ih=>
  have quotient : n/2<2^W:=by
   have p:=Nat.mod_add_div n 2
   have m:=Nat.mod_lt n (by decide : 0<2)
   simp only [Nat.pow_succ] at bound
   omega
  simp only [encode,decode,bit_mod_two,ih (n/2) quotient]
  have h:=Nat.mod_add_div n 2;omega

/-- Fixed-width reference addition. Truncation traversals are explicitly billed. -/
def addAtWidth (W : Nat) (xs ys : List Bool) : Charged (List Bool) :=
 let r:=addBits xs ys
 ⟨r.value.take W,r.work+4*(W+1)⟩

theorem addAtWidth_value (W : Nat) (xs ys : List Bool) (fits : decode xs+decode ys<2^W) :
 decode (addAtWidth W xs ys).value=decode xs+decode ys := by
 simp only [addAtWidth]
 rw [decode_take _ W (by simpa only [addBits_value] using fits),addBits_value]

theorem addAtWidth_work (W : Nat) (xs ys : List Bool) (xl : xs.length≤W) (yl : ys.length≤W) :
 (addAtWidth W xs ys).work≤32*(W+1) := by
 have h:=addCarry_work xs ys false
 simp only [addAtWidth,addBits];omega

theorem scalar_width_bounds (W : Nat) (xs ys : List Bool) (xl : xs.length≤W) (yl : ys.length≤W) :
 (equalBits xs ys).work≤48*(W+1) ∧ (leBits xs ys).work≤48*(W+1) ∧
 (maxBits xs ys).work≤48*(W+1) ∧ (subtractBits xs ys).work≤48*(W+1) := by
 have a:=compare_family_work xs ys
 have b:=subtractBits_work xs ys
 omega

theorem counter_cap_binary (M x : Nat) (bound : x≤4096*(M+1)^8) :
 x<2^(13+8*labelBits (M+1)) := by

@[simp] theorem lengthBits_value {α : Type} (W : Nat) (xs : List α) (fits : xs.length<2^W) :
 decode (lengthBits W xs).value=xs.length := by
 induction xs with
 | nil=>simp [lengthBits,decode_replicate_false]
 | cons x xs ih=>
  have tail : xs.length<2^W:=by simp only [List.length_cons] at fits;omega
  simp only [lengthBits]
  rw [addAtWidth_value W _ [true] (by simpa [ih tail,decode,bit] using fits)]
  simp [ih tail,decode,bit]

theorem lengthBits_work {α : Type} (W : Nat) (xs : List α) (positive : 1≤W) :
 (lengthBits W xs).work≤40*(W+1)*(xs.length+1) := by

def copiedEqual (xs ys : List Bool) : Charged Bool :=
 let a:=copyBits xs;let b:=copyBits ys;let e:=equalBits a.value b.value
 ⟨e.value,a.work+b.work+e.work+4⟩
@[simp] theorem copiedEqual_value (xs ys : List Bool) : (copiedEqual xs ys).value=(decode xs==decode ys) := by
 simp [copiedEqual]
theorem copiedEqual_work (W : Nat) (xs ys : List Bool) (xl : xs.length≤W) (yl : ys.length≤W) :
 (copiedEqual xs ys).work≤56*(W+1) := by
 have h:=(scalar_width_bounds W xs ys xl yl).1
 simp only [copiedEqual,copyBits_value,copyBits_work];omega
end GenericForest.ScalarBits

/-- Representation-boundary evaluation: the scalar provider is equalBits on
finite supplied bit arrays. Encode is the mathematical representation map;
8*(W+1) bills copying the two represented operands, not native Nat conversion. -/
def referenceEq (W x y : Nat) : Charged Bool :=
 copiedEqual (encode W x) (encode W y)
theorem referenceEq_value (W x y : Nat) (hx : x<2^W) (hy : y<2^W) :
 (referenceEq W x y).value=(x==y) := by simp [referenceEq,encode_value W x hx,encode_value W y hy]
theorem referenceEq_work (W x y : Nat) : (referenceEq W x y).work≤56*(W+1) := by
 exact copiedEqual_work W (encode W x) (encode W y) (by simp) (by simp)

/-- Binary equality plus fixed-width binary increment, even for duplicate labels. -/
def bitCount (W x : Nat) : List Nat → Charged Nat
 | []=>⟨0,beta W⟩
 | y::ys=>
  let r:=bitCount W x ys;let e:=referenceEq W x y
  let a:=addAtWidth W (encode W r.value) (encode W (if e.value then 1 else 0))
  ⟨decode a.value,r.work+e.work+a.work+8*(W+1)⟩

theorem bitCount_refines (W x : Nat) (L : List Nat) (hx : x<2^W) (cap : LabelCap W L)
 (length : L.length<2^W) : Refines W (bitCount W x L) (meterCount x L) := by
 induction L with
 | nil=>simp [Refines,bitCount,meterCount]
 | cons y ys ih=>
  have hy:=cap y (by simp)
  have tailCap : LabelCap W ys:=fun z hz=>cap z (by simp [hz])
  have tailLength : ys.length<2^W:=by simp only [List.length_cons] at length;omega
  have r:=ih tailCap tailLength
  have rv : (bitCount W x ys).value=ys.count x:=r.1.trans (meterCount_value x ys)
  have eq:=referenceEq_value W x y hx hy
  have countLength : ys.count x≤ys.length:=List.count_le_length
  have countFits : (bitCount W x ys).value<2^W:=by omega
  have small : (if (referenceEq W x y).value then 1 else 0)<2^W:=by
   split <;> simp only [List.length_cons] at length <;> omega
  have sumFits : (bitCount W x ys).value+(if (referenceEq W x y).value then 1 else 0)<2^W:=by
   split <;> simp only [List.length_cons] at length <;> omega
  have av:=addAtWidth_value W (encode W (bitCount W x ys).value)
   (encode W (if (referenceEq W x y).value then 1 else 0))
   (by simpa only [encode_value W _ countFits,encode_value W _ small] using sumFits)

The next actual implementation binding is the representation boundary:
`referenceEq W x y` describes `copiedEqual (encode W x) (encode W y)`.
The declared work charges the supplied bit-array copy/comparison provider,
not native Nat encode's division/modulo or native Nat.beq. The checked reference
cost therefore cannot be substituted for compiled FastOrdinary runtime until a
persistent binary representation/provider (or measured/proved native scalar
backend) is bound to the actual program, including conversion/copy lifetime.
No native encoder cost or backend assumption is silently introduced here.

The parent also retains current-budget/whole-bill application, Rule5 fresh
max/common-contraction input label cap, all remaining primitive bill scopes and
main/independent acceptance. Exact source constraints remain q=k_opt-1,
conditional c=2.33, no implicit rho. This release changes no production runtime.

def binaryInspectionPolynomial (L n q : Nat) :=
 (256*(L+14+8*labelBits (4*n+q+1)))*(4096*(4*n+q+1)^8)

theorem binary_checked_polynomial (L : Nat) (T : Option Tree) (ss : List Tree) (q : Nat) (F : Forest)
 (proper : ForestState.proper T ss=true) (bits : ∀x∈labels T,labelBits x≤L)
 (payloadLabels : PayloadLabelBits L F) (payload : StatePayloadSize T F) :
 (bitChecked (checkerWidth L T ss q) T ss q F).value=checked T ss q F ∧
 (bitChecked (checkerWidth L T ss q) T ss q F).work≤binaryInspectionPolynomial L (labels T).length q := by
 have h:=binary_checked_inspection_bound L T ss q F (proper_input_bits L T ss proper bits) payloadLabels payload
 have volume:=proper_volume_bound T ss q proper
 have log:=labelBits_mono _ _ volume
 have factor : 256*(L+14+8*labelBits (stateVolume T ss q+1))≤
  256*(L+14+8*labelBits (4*(labels T).length+q+1)):=by omega
 have bill : inspectionBill T ss q≤4096*(4*(labels T).length+q+1)^8:=
  Nat.mul_le_mul_left 4096 (Nat.pow_le_pow_left volume 8)
 exact ⟨h.1,Nat.le_trans h.2 (Nat.mul_le_mul factor bill)⟩

/-- Closed binary-reference checker theorem, with explicit label width and
semantic payload-size assumptions. No desired scalar cost field is supplied. -/
theorem binary_checked_inspection_bound (L : Nat) (T : Option Tree) (ss : List Tree) (q : Nat) (F : Forest)
 (inputs : InputLabelBits L T ss) (payloadLabels : PayloadLabelBits L F) (payload : StatePayloadSize T F) :
 (bitChecked (checkerWidth L T ss q) T ss q F).value=checked T ss q F ∧
 (bitChecked (checkerWidth L T ss q) T ss q F).work≤
 256*(L+14+8*labelBits (stateVolume T ss q+1))*inspectionBill T ss q := by
 let W:=checkerWidth L T ss q
 have positive : 1≤W:=by dsimp [W,checkerWidth];omega
 have LW : L≤W:=by dsimp [W,checkerWidth];omega
 have tc : TargetCap W T:=labelled_cap L W (labels T) LW inputs.1
 have sc : SourcesCap W ss:=fun s hs=>labelled_cap L W (leaves s) LW (inputs.2 s hs)
 have fc : LabelCap W F.flatten:=labelled_cap L W F.flatten LW payloadLabels
 have lab : (labels T).length≤stateVolume T ss q:=by
  have h:=labels_nodes T;dsimp [stateVolume];omega
 have source : (ss.map leaves).flatten.length≤stateVolume T ss q:=by
  have h:=source_leaves_cells ss;dsimp [stateVolume];omega
 have fl : F.length≤stateVolume T ss q:=Nat.le_trans payload.1 lab
 have cells : F.flatten.length≤stateVolume T ss q:=Nat.le_trans payload.2 lab
 have sl : ss.length≤stateVolume T ss q:=by dsimp [stateVolume];omega
 have budget : q≤stateVolume T ss q:=by dsimp [stateVolume];omega
 have r:=bitChecked_refines W T ss q F positive tc sc fc
  (volume_fit L T ss q _ source) (volume_fit L T ss q _ cells)
  (volume_fit L T ss q _ fl) (volume_fit L T ss q _ sl) (volume_fit L T ss q _ budget)
 have old:=checked_work_le_inspection T ss q F payload
 constructor
 · exact r.1.trans (meterChecked_value T ss q F)
 · have h:=Nat.le_trans r.2 (Nat.mul_le_mul_left (beta W) old)
   have factor : beta W=256*(L+14+8*labelBits (stateVolume T ss q+1)):=by
    unfold beta W checkerWidth;congr 1;omega
   rw [factor] at h

/-- Scalar-free pointer/Bool/copy counterpart with conservative slot expansion.
The argument is a named structural source meter; no scalar provider is hidden
in this constructor. Label equality/count/arithmetic calls are replaced below. -/
def pointerLift {α : Type} (W : Nat) (a : Charged α) : Charged α := ⟨a.value,beta W*a.work⟩
theorem pointerLift_refines {α : Type} (W : Nat) (a : Charged α) : Refines W (pointerLift W a) a := ⟨rfl,Nat.le_refl _⟩
theorem referenceEq_refines (W x y : Nat) (hx : x<2^W) (hy : y<2^W) :
 Refines W (referenceEq W x y) ⟨x==y,4⟩ := by
 have h:=referenceEq_work W x y
 exact ⟨referenceEq_value W x y hx hy,by dsimp [beta];omega⟩

def bitPartition (W : Nat) (L : List Nat) (F : List (List Nat)) : Charged Bool :=
 let nonempty:=bitAll W (fun B : List Nat=>pointerLift W ⟨!B.isEmpty,1⟩) F
 let counts:=bitAll W (fun x=>let cells:=pointerLift W (meterFlatten F)
   let cnt:=bitCount W x cells.value;let e:=referenceEq W cnt.value 1
   ⟨e.value,cells.work+cnt.work+e.work⟩) L
 let cells:=pointerLift W (meterFlatten F)
 let labels:=bitAll W (fun x=>bitContains W x L) cells.value
 ⟨nonempty.value&&counts.value&&labels.value,nonempty.work+counts.work+cells.work+labels.work+4*beta W⟩

theorem bitPartition_refines (W : Nat) (L : List Nat) (F : List (List Nat))
 (positive : 1≤W) (lcap : LabelCap W L) (fcap : LabelCap W F.flatten)
 (cellsFit : F.flatten.length<2^W) : Refines W (bitPartition W L F) (meterPartition L F) := by

theorem fast_binary_checked_bound (L : Nat) (T S : Tree) (q : Nat) (F : Forest)
 (proper : DepthOne.proper T S=true) (bits : ∀x∈leaves T,labelBits x≤L)
 (answer : OrdinaryDispatch.FastOrdinary.solve q T S=some F) :
 (bitChecked (checkerWidth L (some T) [S] q) (some T) [S] q F).value=checked (some T) [S] q F ∧
 (bitChecked (checkerWidth L (some T) [S] q) (some T) [S] q F).work≤
 256*(L+14+8*labelBits (stateVolume (some T) [S] q+1))*inspectionBill (some T) [S] q := by
 have pp:=proper
 simp only [DepthOne.proper,Bool.and_eq_true,decide_eq_true_eq] at pp
 have inputs : InputLabelBits L (some T) [S]:=by
  refine ⟨bits,?_⟩
  intro s hs x hx
  have eq : s=S:=by simpa using hs
  subst s
  exact bits x (pp.2.mem_iff.mpr hx)
 have payload:=fast_returned_payload T S q F proper answer
 have payloadLabels : PayloadLabelBits L F:=fun x hx=>bits x (payload.1.mem_iff.mp hx)
 exact binary_checked_inspection_bound L (some T) [S] q F inputs payloadLabels
  (state_payload_ordinary_return _ fast_returned_payload T S q F proper answer)

theorem actual_raw_binary_checks_bound (actual : Ordinary) (L : Nat) (t : Tree) (ss : List Tree)
 (h : Overlap) (q : Nat) (proper : ForestState.proper (some t) ss=true)
 (bits : ∀x∈leaves t,labelBits x≤L) :
 ((recursiveCandidates actual t ss h q).map (fun F=>(bitAccepted (checkerWidth L (some t) ss q) (some t) ss q F).work)).sum≤
 (recursiveCandidates actual t ss h q).length*
  (256*(L+14+8*labelBits (stateVolume (some t) ss q+1))*inspectionBill (some t) ss q) := by
 apply LocalPolynomial.nat_sum_le_constant
 intro F hF
 obtain ⟨io,_,answer⟩:=List.mem_filterMap.mp hF
 dsimp only at answer
 split at answer
 · exact (binary_accepted_inspection_bound L (some t) ss q F
    (proper_input_bits L (some t) ss proper bits)
    (return_payload_bits actual L (some t) _ _ F bits answer)
    (state_payload_forest_return actual (some t) _ _ F answer)).2

theorem fast_scheduled_binary_checked_bound (L : Nat) (t : Tree) (ss : List Tree) (q : Nat)
 (proper : ForestState.proper (some t) ss=true) (bits : ∀x∈leaves t,labelBits x≤L)
 (js : List (Job (Tree×Tree) Forest)) (hjobs : jobs t ss=some js) (xs : List (Nat×Forest))
 (answer : (schedule (fun p b=>(OrdinaryDispatch.FastOrdinary.solve b p.1 p.2).map (fun F=>(F.length-1,F))) q js).answers=some xs) :
 (bitChecked (checkerWidth L (some t) ss q) (some t) ss q (xs.flatMap Prod.snd)).value=
 checked (some t) ss q (xs.flatMap Prod.snd) ∧
 (bitChecked (checkerWidth L (some t) ss q) (some t) ss q (xs.flatMap Prod.snd)).work≤
 256*(L+14+8*labelBits (stateVolume (some t) ss q+1))*inspectionBill (some t) ss q :=
 binary_checked_inspection_bound L (some t) ss q _ (proper_input_bits L (some t) ss proper bits)
  (scheduled_payload_bits _ fast_returned_payload L t ss q proper bits js hjobs xs answer)
  (scheduled_payload _ fast_returned_payload t ss q proper js hjobs xs answer)

theorem binary_proper_inspection_bound (L : Nat) (T : Option Tree) (ss : List Tree) (q : Nat)
 (inputs : InputLabelBits L T ss) :
 (bitProper (checkerWidth L T ss q) T ss).value=proper T ss ∧
 (bitProper (checkerWidth L T ss q) T ss).work≤
 256*(L+14+8*labelBits (stateVolume T ss q+1))*inspectionBill T ss q := by
 let W:=checkerWidth L T ss q
 have positive : 1≤W:=by dsimp [W,checkerWidth];omega
 have LW : L≤W:=by dsimp [W,checkerWidth];omega
 have tc : TargetCap W T:=labelled_cap L W (labels T) LW inputs.1
 have sc : SourcesCap W ss:=fun s hs=>labelled_cap L W (leaves s) LW (inputs.2 s hs)
 have source : (ss.map leaves).flatten.length≤stateVolume T ss q:=by
  have h:=source_leaves_cells ss;dsimp [stateVolume];omega
 have r:=bitProper_refines W T ss positive tc sc (volume_fit L T ss q _ source)
 constructor
 · exact r.1.trans (meterProper_value T ss)
 · have h:=Nat.le_trans r.2 (Nat.mul_le_mul_left (beta W) (proper_work_le_inspection T ss q))
   have factor : beta W=256*(L+14+8*labelBits (stateVolume T ss q+1)):=by
    unfold beta W checkerWidth;congr 1;omega
   rw [factor] at h;exact h

theorem initial_binary_agrees_bound (L : Nat) (T : Option Tree) (ss : List Tree) (q : Nat)
 (proper : ForestState.proper T ss=true) (bits : ∀x∈labels T,labelBits x≤L) :
 (bitAgrees (checkerWidth L T ss q) T ss (ss.map leaves)).value=agrees T ss (ss.map leaves) ∧
 (bitAgrees (checkerWidth L T ss q) T ss (ss.map leaves)).work≤
 256*(L+14+8*labelBits (stateVolume T ss q+1))*inspectionBill T ss q := by
